title: BG graph is missing in small widget
symptom: In the xDrip+ widget, the white dots and the two lines for high and low glucose level disappeared after updating to the latest xDrip+ version (xDrip-plus-20201218-056b822.apk).
cause: The issue was an undesired effect of a change in the 2020-12-18 nightly build, specifically the merge of pull request #1024 from k2s/widget: 'widget improvements'.
fix: The issue was resolved in recent nightlies, and confirmed fixed with commit 1d757ed.
